conservative.requirements: 6 power. You must be exposed to the open sky. Effect: You twist your hands above your head, causing the winds to howl and the clouds to boil with anger. Any creature attempting to fly within extreme range of you between now and your next action must succeed on an Athletics {Dc} check opposed by Spellcraft (Int). If he fails, he is forced out of the sky and down to the ground; he must end his turn on the ground and cannot spend manoeuvres to do anything this turn.

boon.description: The landing is especially violent. The target suffers an additional wound and is prone; he will have to spend a manoeuvre to stand up.
